description: Source code for ESP32 Wi-Fi driver implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including event handling, Wi-Fi connection management, scanning, and interface initialization.

classes.name: esp32_wifi_status
classes.description: Structure holding Wi-Fi network status information including SSID, security, connection state, channel, and RSSI.

classes.name: esp32_wifi_runtime
classes.description: Runtime data structure for Wi-Fi driver, including MAC address, frame buffer, statistics, status, scan callback, and state.

methods.name: wifi_event_handler
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi management events such as DHCP bound, connection, disconnection, and scan completion.

methods.name: esp_event_send_internal
methods.description: Sends internal Wi-Fi events via message queue.

methods.name: esp_wifi_send
methods.description: Transmits a network packet over Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: eth_esp32_rx
methods.description: Receives Ethernet frames over Wi-Fi and pushes them into Zephyr network stack.

methods.name: scan_done_handler
methods.description: Processes Wi-Fi scan results and invokes callback with found access points.

methods.name: esp_wifi_handle_connect_event
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi connection event, updates state, and starts DHCP if enabled.

methods.name: esp_wifi_handle_disconnect_event
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi disconnection event, updates state, and manages reconnection logic.

methods.name: esp_wifi_event_task
methods.description: Main task loop processing Wi-Fi events from message queue.

methods.name: esp32_wifi_connect
methods.description: Initiates Wi-Fi connection with specified parameters.

methods.name: esp32_wifi_scan
methods.description: Starts Wi-Fi network scan with optional parameters and callback.

methods.name: esp32_wifi_ap_enable
methods.description: Enables Wi-Fi Access Point mode with specified SSID and security.

methods.name: esp32_wifi_status
methods.description: Retrieves current Wi-Fi interface status and configuration.

methods.name: esp32_wifi_init
methods.description: Initializes Wi-Fi interface, starts event thread, and sets up DHCP callback.
